From Limp Bizkit · Price: you need corpses nearby, and the zombies are weak.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 2 actions: raise one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} zombie from a corpse within 30 ft (minion, 1 action to command, lasts 1 minute). Rise (reaction, once per round): when a creature dies within 30 ft of your stand, raise it as a zombie, if you have fewer zombies than your limit.
  • 5: Two zombies. Surge: zombies deal @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] extra damage each (at most 2D in all per command), and a creature they critically hit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed}.
  • 9: Three zombies.
  • 13: Four zombies.
  • 17: A zombie raised from a creature that died this fight takes that creature's size, Speeds and Strikes (with their reach and traits), using the zombie's attack bonus and damage. It gains none of the creature's spells or other abilities.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
